items.title: Multiple vulnerabilities, including BlockStrap RCE
items.summary: Adobe released security bulletin APSB26-153 for Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce, fixing 11 vulnerabilities including 5 critical ones. The most severe, BlockStrap (CVE-2026-103849), is a CVSS 10.0 flaw allowing unauthenticated remote code execution through a template engine injection, though no exploitation in the wild was known at the time of release.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type (RCE)
items.summary: CVE-2026-48356, dubbed PolyShell by researchers, is an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (addressed in APSB26-73). It allows unauthenticated attackers to upload malicious files via the guest cart API, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution and privilege escalation. This vulnerability has been actively exploited in the wild, with CISA adding it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 27, 2026.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Zero-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler (CVE-2026-75650), a zero-day vulnerability in Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Attacks began on September 4, 2026, leading Adobe to release an emergency hotfix on September 7, 2026, for this CVSS 10.0 flaw. The vulnerability involves injecting malicious code into Magento's template system.

items.title: SessionReaper: Unauthenticated RCE
items.summary: SessionReaper (CVE-2025-54236) is a critical vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that can grant full control of a store to unauthenticated attackers. While initially disclosed in September 2025, active exploitation of this bug was reported to have started by October 22, 2026, with automated attacks hitting a significant percentage of stores.

items.title: Multiple vulnerabilities, including unauthenticated customer account takeover
items.summary: Adobe released APSB26-92, an update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, addressing seven vulnerabilities. This includes an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1, alongside other issues leading to security feature bypass, privilege escalation, and application denial-of-service.
